limitations: No textual labels or contextual cues confirm symbolic intent; color and scale alone do not fix meaning.

alternative_interpretations: The style may simply reflect artistic economy—minimalist representation—not philosophical statement.
limitations: Stylization alone does not prove intent to comment on identity; similar forms appear in non-critical decorative art.
